Announcement ## SF Flow Utility Toolkit is Live on Firefox and Microsoft Edge

SF Flow Utility Toolkit is now available on Firefox Add-ons and Microsoft Edge Add-ons, alongside the existing Chrome Web Store listing.

The same feature set is available on all three browsers. The extension is built from browser-specific manifests so that each listing matches what its store expects:

  • Chrome and Edge run the extension as a Manifest V3 service worker
  • Firefox runs it as a background script, with a minimum supported version of Firefox 126

No data collection permissions are requested on any browser.

Please be aware that the Chrome version may be more up-to-date than the Firefox and Microsoft Edge versions. Chrome updates are typically available within the hour, while Firefox and Microsoft Edge can take several business days to review and approve updates.

To install the extension, please visit:

Google Chrome

Firefox

Microsoft Edge
